title: regime_label 6m return uses calendar 180-day lookback not exactly 126 trading sessions
description: scripts/regime_label_daily.py compute_6m_return uses calendar 180-day lookback. Strict spec is 126 trading sessions (per Chinese A-share calendar ~252 sessions/year, 6m = 126). Calendar-based approximation is acceptable for simple_quadrant initial method but introduces small bias when applied to regime windows containing extended holidays (Spring Festival cluster, October golden week). Codex REV-7 P2.2 (drawer 51d5169388...). Acceptable for current dev cron-disabled state; document as known approximation, can refine before production cron enable.
reproduce_command: manual: pytest scripts/test_regime_label.py + check 126 trading days vs 180 calendar days bias
required_verification: Compute back-test bias between 126-trading-day vs 180-calendar-day windows over 5y CSI300
Either accept and document, or migrate to trading calendar lookup
closure_requirements: Document approximation in regime_label_daily docstring + design doc
Or implement trading-calendar lookup before prod cron enable
